## Description

A segment is a saved filter: last visit, age band, location, service used, outstanding balance, marketing consent. It shows a count and, to admins, the list.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Diagnoses and clinical notes are not offered as filters.
- [ ] **AC2.** Counts under 5 are shown as "fewer than 5" outside the patient list.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
